name: mf_sc_noise
description: A collection of noise UGens from supercollider conceptually ported to MayaFlux Nodes

name: mf_follow
description: Envelope following for audio: attack/release peak and RMS kernels in Kinesis, a block-level EnvelopeProcessor with feature, signal and gain outputs and sidechain input, and a per-sample EnvelopeFollower node.

name: mf_vocalic
description: Splits a recorded voice into its speech, its vowels and its consonants with MayaFlux's speech networks, and loops the vowels and consonants with a level and speed each.

name: mf_gamepads
description: Gamepad layouts for HIDNode, so south, left_x or dpad_up name the same control on a DualShock 4 or DualSense (USB or Bluetooth), a Switch Pro Controller or Joy-Con, an Xbox Wireless pad over Bluetooth, or any pad with the Android HID layout.

name: mf_kinect
description: A camera source for the first Kinect through libfreenect. Depth in millimetres, depth lined up with colour, or colour, as a CameraContainer that goes to Graphics like any camera.

name: mf_voicegen
description: Speech synthesis on MayaFlux's tensor kernels: PyTorch checkpoints read without Python, the kernels vocoders need, and the Vocos vocoder.
